tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Commissioner of Service Tax issued show cause cum demand notice dated February 18, 2016, received by the company on February 22, 2016 for Rs.7.87 crore stating that for the period 2009-10 to 2013-14 the company has failed to reverse CENVAT Credit as per rules. The Company had filed an appeal in CESTAT.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Customs Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
tax_litigation.status: The Honb’le CESTAT vide it’s order dated July 15, 2026 did not find any merits in the impugned order, insofar as it has confirmed the adjudged demands on the company. Therefore, the impugned order is set aside and appeal is allowed in favour of the appellants.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Petitions filed by the Company related to the levy of value added tax on the supply of food and non-alcoholic beverages by the Company's restaurants for the assessment years 2006-07, 2007-08 and 2008-09, on the ground of the applicable rate of tax under Section 7(1)(a)/7(1)(b) of the Tamil Nadu Value Added Tax Act, 2006. The Tribunal, by way of their Order, has held that no error apparent on the face of the record exists warranting rectification, and has accordingly dismissed all six Petitions, thereby affirming its earlier orders viz. order dated August 28, 2015, and order dated March 13, 2017
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Tamil Nadu Sales Tax Appellate Tribunal (Additional Bench), Chennai
tax_litigation.status: The Company had, at the time of filing of the Petitions, deposited the demanded amount of ₹ 1,71,68,672/- with the relevant authorities. Since the said amount stands deposited, the Order does not entail any cash flow impact on the Company. The Company is in discussions with its tax advisors and evaluating the same. The Company will pursue legal remedies as may be available and advised.
